label: SAP Developer
summary: Two SAP Developer Resumes against Human Resources and SQL Developer.
job_description:
L.L.Bean is hiring a senior SAP Developer to build and support the ABAP extensions behind its retail and supply-chain processes.

What we need:
- 5+ years SAP ABAP development
- Strong SAP ECC experience
- On-call support responsibilities
- SAP ECC
- SAP Transport
- Vendor Management

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Bachelors in Computer Science; SAP transport and debug expertise; Technical specification authoring; Integration design and implementation; Vendor partnership and liaison; ABAP; Integration; Debugging; COTS Packages; Testing.
